mathematical_definition.anchor: A=stopgrad(Y_anchor) from the already required target endpoint prediction in fixed receptor coordinates. Use the exact reference landmarks p_r; no rigid frame realignment or atom-type/graph acceptance rule.
mathematical_definition.attention: a_i=stopgrad[0.25+sum_{r=0}^{19}w_r*exp(-||A_i-p_r||^2/(2*5^2))], w=[1,0,...,0]. Thus every active coordinate retains a_i>=.25. For this first trial, region amplitude is constant over the learned window; the Gaussian varies spatially through the detached anchor.
mathematical_definition.prototypes: Use K=4 separate coherent elite point clouds and Hungarian correspondences in the receptor frame. T_ki denotes prototype k coordinates permuted by its frozen correspondence. Do not replace alternatives with an averaged coordinate cloud, resample/clone particles or condition acceptance on atom/graph identity.
mathematical_definition.priors: pi_k is the normalized positive offline teacher prior supplied by the registered K4 point-cloud construction, configured with teacher_score_beta=2 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4. Freeze prototype choice and these priors before differentiation. These are recorded model score labels, not an affinity head in the loss or measured biochemical affinity; this task does not reread the registered prior-construction source.
mathematical_definition.squared_distance: q_k(Y)=sum_i a_i*||Y_i-T_ki||^2 / sum_i a_i, in A^2.
mathematical_definition.reward: R(Y)=tau*logsumexp_k(log(pi_k)-rho_k/tau), tau=.5. Normalized pi and nonnegative rho give R<=0, a finite upper bound; there is no finite lower bound. Keep alternatives separate inside logsumexp.
mathematical_definition.coordinate_gradient: For frozen a,T,pi define omega_k=softmax_k(log(pi_k)-rho_k/tau). Then grad_{Y_i}R=-sum_k omega_k*[a_i/(sum_j a_j*sqrt(1+q_k/delta^2))]*(Y_i-T_ki). This targets matched prototype coordinates, not a constant signed increase of soft mass or universal covariance compression.
mathematical_definition.endpoint_pullback: g_t=J_{F_theta}(x_t)^T*grad_Y R on the already required model forward. Only actual predicted coordinates carry gradients; affinity head, self-conditioning, anchor, attention, assignments, prototype priors and reference are detached.
